symbols.name: OperationProfilingQuery
symbols.summary: Defines bounded UTC filters, completion/start/overlap selection and stable paging.

syntax.content: public static bool operator !=(OperationProfilingQuery? left, OperationProfilingQuery? right)
public static bool operator ==(OperationProfilingQuery? left, OperationProfilingQuery? right)

symbols.name: Id
symbols.summary: Gets an optional occurrence identifier filter.

symbols.name: ParentOperationId
symbols.summary: Gets an optional non-owning parent identifier filter.

symbols.name: ApplicationVersion
symbols.summary: Gets an ordinal application version filter.

symbols.name: IntervalOverlap
symbols.summary: Gets whether the UTC window selects observed interval overlap for Runtime navigation.

symbols.name: StartedWithin
symbols.summary: Gets whether the UTC window selects operation start times, as used by the event timeline. Mutually exclusive with interval overlap.

symbols.name: HasSegmentFailures
symbols.summary: Gets an observed failed-segment filter, independent of root outcome.

symbols.name: SegmentKey
symbols.summary: Gets a case-insensitive leaf key filter.

symbols.name: SegmentPath
symbols.summary: Gets an exact structured full-path filter.

symbols.name: HttpMethod
symbols.summary: Gets an HTTP method filter.

symbols.name: Route
symbols.summary: Gets an original endpoint route filter.

symbols.name: HttpStatusCode
symbols.summary: Gets a final observable HTTP status filter.

symbols.name: ApplicationRequestId
symbols.summary: Gets the HTTP application request identifier.

symbols.name: SamplingStrategyKey
symbols.summary: Gets a request sampling strategy filter.

symbols.name: SamplingConfigurationKey
symbols.summary: Gets an effective sampling configuration filter.

symbols.name: GroupByHttpMethod
symbols.summary: Gets optional method grouping in addition to kind/key.

symbols.name: Cursor
symbols.summary: Gets an opaque provider-authenticated continuation key.

symbols.name: SegmentDimensions
symbols.summary: Gets predicates that must all match the same selected segment summary.

symbols.name: SegmentOutcomes
symbols.summary: Gets selected observed invocation outcomes on the matching segment path.

symbols.name: FromUtc
symbols.summary: Gets optional inclusive completion UTC; omitted values use the paging boundary or fifteen minutes before the resolved end.

symbols.name: ToUtc
symbols.summary: Gets optional exclusive completion UTC; omitted values use the paging boundary or the current UTC time on each new query.

symbols.name: Kind
symbols.summary: Gets an optional invariant execution-kind filter.

symbols.name: Key
symbols.summary: Gets an optional invariant operation-key filter.

symbols.name: KeyContains
symbols.summary: Gets an optional invariant, case-insensitive substring filter on the operation key.

symbols.name: NodeId
symbols.summary: Gets an optional executing process filter.

symbols.name: CorrelationId
symbols.summary: Gets lookup-only correlation filtering.

symbols.name: Outcomes
symbols.summary: Gets selected observed outcomes.

symbols.name: Dimensions
symbols.summary: Gets at most eight typed predicates.

symbols.name: GroupDimensions
symbols.summary: Gets at most four exact or missing dimension values selecting one previously grouped bucket independently of general predicates.

symbols.name: GroupingDimensions
symbols.summary: Gets at most four dimension grouping names. Only operations containing every selected dimension participate in the selection.

symbols.name: View
symbols.summary: Gets Slow, Recent or ByCount mode.

symbols.name: PageSize
symbols.summary: Gets the bounded page size.

symbols.name: MaximumAnalysisCount
symbols.summary: Gets the exact analysis bound.

symbols.name: Boundary
symbols.summary: Gets an optional existing publication boundary.
